documents.description: Documents in the index, 6 to 24. topic indexes into topics. source is shown beside a match in the results: icon is Simple Icons path data (painted in color, or the text color when color is left out), an image URL for a full color logo, or a ReactNode. x and y place the point on the plane from -1 to 1; left out, points spiral around their topic's center.

topics.description: Topics the documents cluster by, two to four. Each gets a region of the plane, a dashed cluster, and a name chip. color overrides the chart series color.

query.description: The search query, typed into the readout before it is embedded.

queryAt.description: Where the query lands on the plane, from -1 to 1. Defaults to beside the first document of the second topic.

k.description: How many nearest documents are returned, from 1 to 5.

dimensions.description: Embedding size shown in the readout heading.

labels.description: Stage names in the step bar, the three counter names, the readout headings, the results heading, and the chip on the falling query.

speed.description: Multiplies the pace. At 1 the whole story takes about 18 seconds. 0 holds still.

paused.description: Holds the diagram still where it is, easing to rest instead of stopping in one frame.

controls.description: Shows the step bar with play and pause above the diagram.

accent.description: Color of the query, the search path and signal, the ring, the match lines, and the score bars. Defaults to the accent token.

label.description: Accessible description of the diagram. Built from the topics, the query, the hop count, and the real matches with their scores when left out.

caption.description: Optional visible caption under the diagram, rendered as a figcaption.

style.description: Inline styles on the root figure.
